title: IMAP location fingerprint and recent-id lookups: database plan evidence

method.engine: PostgreSQL 14, new databases created from template0, dropped after use; synthetic data only
method.plans: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) of the exact prepared statements, plan_cache_mode custom and generic, first and repeat, rolled back
method.statistics: fresh = VACUUM ANALYZE after load; stale = ANALYZE after ~1% of the data, autovacuum off, then the rest
method.notClaimed: no wall-time, native, production or real-provider claims; buffers, rows and plan shape only

redOldAnyForm.statement: previous location-fingerprint lookup: fingerprint = ANY($2) with ORDER BY key COLLATE "C"
redOldAnyForm.finding: generic plan used imap_state_location_fingerprints with Index Cond (link_id = $1) only and the fingerprint as a filter: 101,077 buffers for 0, 1 or 2 result rows on the 100,000-location account (custom plans 3-5)
redOldAnyForm.note: fresh statistics only; the run stopped at a harness error after these requests (classified below)

greenKeyDrivenLookup.statement: DISTINCT unnest(requested digests) -> per-digest equality LATERAL (link_id, kind = location, fingerprint) OFFSET 0 -> ORDER BY key COLLATE "C"
